root_cause.text: The use of `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)` after `FD_PREPARE()` nullified the `src_info` pointer, but the subsequent code still referenced the now-NULL pointer to add the source info to the global list, causing a null pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "after call to retain_and_null_ptr(src_info), src_info is re-used for adding it to the global list." The patch diff shows the old code sequence: `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info);` then `spin_lock_irqsave(&hvpipe_src_list_lock, flags);` ... `list_add(&src_info->list, &hvpipe_src_list);` which accesses `src_info` after it has been set to NULL.
